note: Stages are built from the official trophy descriptions alone: story order from the named missions and chapters, then stranger strands, then the counted collectibles and activities, then free-roam crime, then 100% completion and the platinum.

stages.goal: Finish the story, and pick up every story trophy on the way. Play the chapters in order and do each named mission once, cleanly.
stages.tip: The story trophies are the only ones tied to single missions. If a mission run goes wrong, restart it from the pause menu instead of moving on — the trophy needs a completed run of that mission.
stages.title: 1 · Play the story

stages.goal: Clear the stranger strands. Five of them end in a named finale mission with its own trophy, and all eight finished strands together earn the silver.
stages.tip: Stranger markers appear as you travel. Clear a strand when it shows up instead of letting five of them pile up for the endgame.
stages.title: 2 · Strangers & friends

stages.goal: Open the whole map and tick off the travelling collectibles: every area, a hundred vehicles, the garages, the Scooter Bros registrations and a cocktail on Ocean Beach.
stages.tip: One long road trip covers most of this stage. Drive everywhere, try every new vehicle, and detour into every settlement you pass.
stages.title: 3 · See all of Leonida

stages.goal: Hunt the counted collectibles: three full card sets and a hundred WAiNK check-ins, plus all eighteen meditation spots.
stages.tip: Cards hide in corners, rooftops and interiors — explore thoroughly. WAiNK spots and meditation spots fall out of the same road trips.
stages.title: 4 · Collectibles

stages.goal: Work the activities: stunts, all nine activity types, gold in every shooting-range challenge, drone races, twenty race wins, fishing, the arcade, challenges and bowling.
stages.tip: Start these early — stunts and challenges count passively while you play. Save the shooting range golds for when your aim is warm.
stages.title: 5 · Activities & skill

stages.goal: The free-roam crime set: wanted escapes with your partner, shop and vault robberies, Combat Focus, the airport, the tanks, the gangs, the showroom, and the money trophies.
stages.tip: Do the money trophies last in this stage: laundering $250,000 and spending $100,000 both feed off the robberies you do for the other trophies here.
stages.title: 6 · Crime & chaos

stages.goal: Reach 100% completion, then watch the platinum pop. By this point it is a checklist of whatever the stats screen says is still short.
stages.tip: Open the pause menu's stats screen and attack the thinnest category first. Nothing here can be missed — only left unfinished.
stages.title: 7 · 100% & platinum
